data.title: 入巢莳菜 · 泳池边草莓雪糕与飞溅水花
data.description: 美浜学园阳光炽烈的户外泳池边，莳菜身着带荷叶边的草莓图案比基尼坐在池边踢水。一手抓着快要融化的草莓甜筒雪糕，双脚溅起晶莹水花，双马尾随风晃荡，冲着镜头吐出舌头露出恶作剧得逞的古灵精怪大笑。
data.action: 坐在池边踢起水花，手握雪糕做鬼脸大笑
data.lighting: 烈日下闪闪发光的泳池水面反光
data.promptProse: Sitting on the sun-warmed pool edge in her frilly strawberry bikini, she kicks up a spray of shimmering water. Her floor-length candy-pink twintails sway as she licks her ice cream and flashes a mischievous, carefree grin.
data.animaCaption: She kicks water from the pool edge with an ice cream cone, laughing playfully at the viewer.
